info.title: SYNTHORA keyless web search for AI agents
info.description: Keyless web search for AI agents. Give it a natural-language query and it returns ranked organic results (title, url, snippet) from live multi-source search (DuckDuckGo HTML/Lite plus public SearXNG instances, with automatic fallback so it never returns empty when one source flakes). Optionally fetches the top result and extracts the main content as clean, token-budgeted markdown (answer_extract), so an agent can read the page without running its own crawler/browser/scraper. Use it to answer real-world questions, gather fresh facts, research a topic, find docs or check what a site says, without maintaining a search index or paying for Google/Bing/Serper API keys. Resilient (short timeouts, multi-source), SSRF-hardened. 0.005 USDC on Base. SYNTHORA.
x-use-cases: answer a real-world question with fresh web results
research a topic without a search index
find documentation for a library or API
extract the main content of the top result as markdown
replace paid Google/Bing/Serper API keys with a pay-per-call search
